Follow the section 'Step 5b' of docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md item by item for what changed, and check that nothing else changed.

WHAT TO CHECK: (1) The change since pass 3 (step-05f-test-design-validator.json) is only the test 'isolation' of tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js and its helpers. The copy of the file that pass 3 checked (sha256 e87fc3ee8850b6d1…) no longer exists (issue I6 of 05g re-run 2), so show it by facts: every other file of the run (git status --short lists them) has a modification time before the start of step 05g (2026-11-09T01:51:31Z) and equals any hash recorded for it in the handoffs 05e and 05f; tracked files show no diff other than the run's; decisions/0109 got only the addenda of ORCH; read the whole diff of picker.e2e.js against the file at the end of step 05e (rebuild it from the clone of tag base/E2E105-20261105-01 plus the handoffs if you can, or else read the whole test 'isolation' and its helpers as new code) and confirm the other eight tests and their helpers did not change in meaning. The comment about «Средний» (I4) states the measured fact. The timing class T1-T3 is recorded by О21 and is not a finding unless you find a way by facts inside the rules of the spec. (4) Runs: 'isolation' alone in a series of dozens of runs under load and quiet (AP-115); the independence loop of the nine spec tests (each name alone: exit 0, exactly one line that starts with 'ok ', and it is 'ok 1 - <name>'); npm run -s e2e -- picker three times in a row (one Chrome at a time) with duration_ms; the two kit files three times; the counts of test( and assert. not lower than at the start of 05g re-run 2 (picker.e2e.js 156 assert., 13 test(; it reports 159 / 13; e2e-stand.test.js 211 / 22, unchanged); npm run check once at the end, exit 0. (5) Verdict PASS only if every item of Step 5b holds; otherwise FAIL with findings ranked. Known and recorded for step 10, not a finding of this change: the old test files leave folders in the system temporary root (step 05, issue I11).

RULES: do not change any project file other than this handoff, and do not commit, push or pull; the verdict goes only into this handoff. Kill processes only by explicit pid and only your own; the eight old 'node -e setInterval' processes of this machine are not yours. issues.text: Outside criterion 6 as recorded, for ORCH to record or decide (H5): B's error answer to A's set may carry other data of A than its strings and solution names. The set of criterion 6 is A's questionnaire texts; the criterion asks the error answer for no solution name of A; the addendum after the second pass gives it the list rule, and О19 its three keys. H5 (the message is the summary of A's first solution) survives. If ORCH wants it inside: pin the measured error body ({error: 'answers_invalid', message: 'Ответы не подходят к этой анкете. Пройдите анкету ещё раз.', question: null}, the same in both pairs), which would also make O7 and G08 red without the list.

Outside criterion 6 by the recorded class (H6): a text of A in the document of an iframe of B's page (here an iframe with no address, filled from A's name kept in window.name) is not read: the textContent and the tree walk of B's document do not enter it, as for a shadow root, which О20 'Outside criterion 6' names. The iframe is not named there; ORCH records it with the shadow root, or decides otherwise.

Outside the storage clause as read (H7): criterion 6 reads the storage when B's card opens ('the storage still holds only A's key'), and О19 extended only the page, the requests and the keys to B's whole pass. A's name written into B's own stored value during B's pass is not read (criterion 5's storage test reads only uchet-pro alone). ORCH records it as outside, or extends the reading (the measured fix would be: after B's pass, B's stored value has the five fields of criterion 5 and holds nothing of A).

Outside criterion 6 (H8): what B's page sends (the query or the body of its requests) is not read; criterion 6 reads B's answers, and О19 where B's requests go. A's name in the query of B's result request survives. ORCH records it as outside, or decides otherwise.

For step 10 (DOC-UPDATER, with О19-О21): design section 16 gains my mutants H1-H8 with their results, the findings F7-F9 (Low) and their measured fixes, and the outside items of I1-I4; F8 goes with the kit defect of О21. The counts of picker.e2e.js: test( 13 (9 top-level), assert. 159.

Three shapes of one lesson, found by H1, H3, H4: an exemption must be as narrow as its reason (skip the two checked records by id, not a whole address prefix); a control read once at the end proves nothing about a thing that can remove itself before that read (a service worker); a rule about where a word may stand must read the text as the visitor reads it (the innermost element), not the nodes as the page built them.
